formulations.Polymer system Notes: Commercial poly(ethylene carbonate) (PEC), Mn = 3.7x10^4, donated by a Japanese company. Purified by dissolving in chloroform, precipitating into excess methanol, then vacuum drying at 60 °C for 24 h. 1H/13C NMR: about 95% carbonate units in the main chain, the rest ethylene oxide units. Salt concentration is given as mol% Li+ per EC monomer unit ([Li+]/[EC] = 1/20 to 1/1.25).
formulations.Notes: Transparent self-standing film. Film cast on a plastic dish and kept several hours in a dry N2 chamber before vacuum drying. FT-IR: 55% of C=O groups interacting with Li+.
formulations.Reference: Y. Tominaga, K. Yamazaki, V. Nanthana, J. Electrochem. Soc. 162 (2) A3133-A3136 (2015)
